instruction: Look at bore_plate.step in NX CAM. Spot drill and drill the four through holes in bore_plate.step. Machine the two stepped holes using Bore, Profile, or Pocket operations. Through holes must break through the bottom by 1 mm and stepped holes must bottom at Z=9.000 mm. Tool definitions: T1 is a spot drill, T2 is a 6 mm drill, and T3 is a 10 mm flat end mill for bore/profile/pocket operations. Write the required output file(s) using exactly these Desktop path(s): C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-8.nc.
